pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: Introduce the ProjectManagement (TFG) system: a Java JAX-RS/Jersey REST backend with Hibernate persistence over MySQL, plus a static HTML/JS web front-end, deployed as jersey-webapp.war into Tomcat via Docker Compose. Explain repo layout ('old/Código fuente/Servidor/TFGRest', db/, tomcat/, docker-compose.yml) and link to child pages.

pages.title: Domain Model and Concepts
pages.purpose: Explain the academic domain: Profesor, Linea (project line), Estudiante, Reunion, EstadoTrabajo, TipoLinea, TipoReunion, Credenciales, Fichero — and how they map to DB tables.

page_notes.content: Show the content with emojis and well-organized structure

pages.title: Getting Started / Running Locally
pages.purpose: How to build the WAR (Maven pom.xml), deploy into ./tomcat, run docker-compose (mysql_tfg, web, adminer), and initialize the DB from db/tfg.sql.

pages.title: REST Backend (Jersey Web Application)
pages.purpose: Overview of the server-side application: JAX-RS resources, security filter, DAO layer, and model classes. Links to child pages.

pages.title: REST API Endpoints (MyResource)
pages.purpose: Document services/MyResource.java: /profesores resource tree, login, professor registration, nested /lineas, /estudiantes, /reuniones endpoints, file upload/download (Fichero), status codes and JSON payloads.

pages.title: Authentication and Authorization
pages.purpose: JWT issuance in login (jjwt, MacProvider key), the @Secured annotation and RestSecurityFilter, Authorization: Bearer headers, and per-professor ownership checks (hasAccessLinea).

pages.title: Persistence Layer (DAO + Hibernate)
pages.purpose: Overview of the dao package: FactoriaDAO abstract factory, Hibernate implementations, SessionUtil. Links to children.

pages.title: DAO Factory and Interfaces
pages.purpose: FactoriaDAO/FactoriaHibernateDAO pattern and the ProfesorDAO, LineaDAO, EstudianteDAO, ReunionDAO contracts.

pages.title: Hibernate Sessions and Mappings
pages.purpose: SessionUtil/SessionFactory bootstrapping, hibernate configuration, entity annotations/mappings, transaction handling and cascade behaviour.

pages.title: Validation and Model Classes
pages.purpose: modelo package: entity beans, enums (EstadoTrabajo, TipoLinea, TipoReunion), Credenciales, Fichero, and Validacion input-validation rules used by the resource layer.

pages.title: Web Front-End
pages.purpose: Overview of the static client under src/main/webapp/tfg: HTML pages, CSS, and JavaScript that consume the REST API. Links to child pages.

pages.title: Pages and Navigation
pages.purpose: index.html, login.html, registro*.html (registroTFG, registroEstudiante, registroReunion), consulta*.html, calificar.html, index.jsp; shared header and CSS (login.css, main.css, shared.css).

pages.title: Client-Side JavaScript and API Access
pages.purpose: js/config.js base URL, login.js token storage, header.js, registro*/consulta* scripts, validation.js, and paginathing.js pagination; AJAX patterns and auth header usage.

pages.title: Database and Deployment Infrastructure
pages.purpose: Overview of persistence and runtime infrastructure. Links to child pages.

pages.title: MySQL Schema (db/tfg.sql)
pages.purpose: Table-by-table walkthrough of profesor, linea, estudiante, reunion, keys, cascading deletes and charset/engine choices.

pages.title: Docker Compose Environment
pages.purpose: Services db (mysql_tfg), web (tomcat) and adminer, port mappings, volumes (./db init scripts, ./tomcat webapps), credentials and service links.

pages.title: Build and WAR Packaging
pages.purpose: Maven pom.xml dependencies (Jersey, Hibernate, MySQL connector, jjwt), WAR structure (WEB-INF/web.xml, classes, lib) and deployment flow of jersey-webapp.war.

pages.title: Glossary
pages.purpose: Define 15-30 codebase-specific terms with code pointers: TFG, Profesor, Linea, Estudiante, Reunion, Vocales, estadoTrabajo, fechaEstimada, urlGit, urlInforme, urlMemoriaFinal, tipoLinea, tipoReunion, Credenciales, Validacion, FactoriaDAO, SessionUtil, @Secured, RestSecurityFilter, MyResource, JAX-RS, Jersey, WAR, adminer, mysql_tfg, paginathing, Eclipse .metadata/.history.
